decisions.reason: Requiring white captions without text effects does not change the independently specified caption font; the same message's font instruction is already represented separately.

Caption color and text-effect restrictions do not alter the separate general visual-editing state; the message's restrictions on animations and flashy transitions are already represented by a same-message MODIFY.
Caption color and effects do not affect narrative completeness; the message's separate narrative instruction is already represented.
The caption-style change does not alter the assigned count, and the message's separate instruction to redo and resubmit all eight clips is already represented.
Caption color and effects do not change the substantive moment-selection standard; the message addresses moment value in a separate clause.
The caption-style decision does not change the 20-to-120-second duration bounds.
White captions and removal of text effects do not change the hook-selection criterion.
The caption-style decision does not change permitted source material, source exclusions, or the one-video batch constraint.
The caption-style decision does not change the target of 180 approved clips per month or its counting basis.
